overview_description.description:
Getbee is a Dubai-founded SaaS company transforming the online sales experience through live video commerce and virtual customer engagement solutions. Established in 2017, the company enables businesses to connect customers directly with sales representatives through real-time video calls, bringing a more personal, interactive, and human-centered approach to digital shopping.

Operating within the digital sales enablement and customer experience market, Getbee helps businesses replicate the in-store sales experience online by allowing customers to instantly interact with sales experts, request live product demonstrations, and schedule appointments from anywhere. The platform is designed to improve trust, engagement, and conversion rates by making virtual selling more authentic and convenient.

Getbee serves a broad international client base across sectors such as automotive, retail, e-commerce, and consumer services, with customers spanning the United States, Europe, and the Middle East. Its technology integrates seamlessly with existing e-commerce ecosystems, enabling businesses to enhance online customer journeys without disrupting existing infrastructure.

The company operates on a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) business model, generating revenue through subscription-based pricing plans tailored to different business needs and feature requirements. In addition to virtual selling capabilities, Getbee provides analytics and reporting tools that allow organizations to monitor key performance indicators such as call duration, customer engagement, conversion rates, and revenue generation.

By combining live human interaction with scalable digital technology, Getbee is redefining virtual commerce and helping businesses create more personalized, effective, and data-driven online sales experiences.
